tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on cream, paper and the three tints. Ground of title, section and closing slides. 13.5:1 on cream.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Presenter chrome background around the stage. Not used on slides.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Presenter chrome panels: contents list and bottom bar. Text on it: cream, soft.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Default slide ground. Text on ink grounds. Text on it: ink, slate, burnt.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Card and row surface on a cream slide. Text on it: ink, slate, burnt.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: 1px border of cards and rows on paper.

tokens.name: sand-deep
tokens.usage: Decorative line icons beside tag rows. Never carries text.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Body copy and bullets on paper and cream. 7.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary row text on paper at 24px or larger only. 3.6:1 on paper, so never smaller.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Subtitle and byline on ink grounds. 8.8:1 on ink.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the presenter chrome, on panel and deep.

tokens.name: yolk
tokens.usage: Accent: number badges, progress fill, primary button, kicker on ink grounds, band text on ink. Dark text on it: ink (8:1).

tokens.name: yolk-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of the chip on yolk-tint.

tokens.name: burnt
tokens.usage: Kicker, links and emphasis on cream and paper (5.1:1). Never on ink (2.7:1).

tokens.name: yolk-tint
tokens.usage: Chip fill and the tool note fill. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: burnt-tint
tokens.usage: AI-help note fill. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: ink-tint
tokens.usage: Review note fill. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline border in the presenter chrome on panel and deep.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per title, section and closing slide. Cream on ink.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide title on content slides. Ink on cream.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Line under the display text. Mist on ink.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: One-sentence claim under the title. Ink on cream.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Title of a numbered row and of a flow card.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Bullets in cards. Slate on paper.

styles.name: row-text
styles.usage: Text under a row title. Muted on paper.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Small label above the title, set in capitals. Burnt on cream, yolk on ink.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Chip and note rows at the foot of a slide. Ink on a tint.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Prompt and code text in presenter dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a row title and its text.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between rows, and between title block items.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge and its row text.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between the two cards, and row side padding.

tokens.name: margin-x
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margin on content slides.

tokens.name: margin-top
tokens.usage: Top slide margin on content slides.

tokens.name: margin-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom slide margin on content slides.

tokens.name: margin-cover
tokens.usage: Slide margin on title, section and closing slides.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Note rows at the foot of a slide.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, rows and the closing band.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chip in the slide header.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Number badges and the title slide discs. Any box up to 512px wide becomes round.
